ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a cubed sphere grid type.
description: Gnomonic (FV3 grid_type=0) cubed-sphere grid C96: six tiles of 96 x 96 cells (55296 cells in total), no stretching or nesting. Cell sizes are not uniform: cell width ranges from about 82 km (tile corners) to 116 km (tile centres), with a mean of about 96 km (nominal resolution 100 km).
